articles.title: Incredible Michael Block drama, young American streak continues on PGA Tour and Joaquin Niemann does it again - Fox News
articles.description: Michael Brennan fired a final round 64 to win the Wyndham Championship by three shots, extending a young American winning streak on the PGA Tour.
articles.content:
